elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1 requires HDI to “defend” the Company and its affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1 requires HDI to indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from any third-party claim.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1(a) covers allegations that the Site, Services, software, tools, technology, or other HDI-provided deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual-property rights.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1(b) expressly covers HDI’s breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1(c) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content, Confidential Information, or customer data caused by HDI.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1(d) expressly covers HDI’s gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: HDI’s obligations are conditioned on the Company promptly notifying HDI of the claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1 permits HDI to control the defense and settlement, subject to Company consent for specified settlements.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1 requires the Company to provide reasonable cooperation at HDI’s expense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.2 limits the Company’s indemnity to Company-provided Content or Marks and the Company’s breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: Section 9A.1(a) indemnifies the Company against third-party claims alleging infringement or misappropriation by the Site, Services, or HDI-provided deliverables.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: The clause excludes claims arising from Company-provided Content or Marks, but contains no exclusion for Customer modifications.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No exclusion addresses infringement caused by combining the covered items with Customer or third-party materials.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No exclusion expressly addresses infringement caused by compliance with Customer specifications.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no obligation to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no fee-refund remedy tied to the unavailability of the other IP remedies.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No three-times-annual-fees super-cap applies to HDI’s indemnity.
